### White Boy Rick (2018) — Crime, Survival & The Price of Power 🎬

White Boy Rick is a crime drama based on the true story of Richard Wershe Jr., played by Richie Merritt, a teenager growing up in 1980s Detroit. Surrounded by poverty, crime, and a struggling community, Rick becomes involved with the FBI as an informant while still underage, hoping to help his family and find a way out of their difficult circumstances.

As Rick becomes more deeply connected to the drug trade, he begins navigating a dangerous world where money and influence come with serious consequences. What starts as an opportunity to cooperate with law enforcement gradually turns into a complicated situation that places his future at risk.

The film explores family loyalty, corruption, poverty, ambition, and the consequences of choices made at a young age. It reveals how vulnerable people can become trapped between powerful institutions and dangerous street realities.

What makes White Boy Rick compelling is its portrayal of a teenager caught between two worlds, forced to face adult consequences before he fully understands the risks. His story raises difficult questions about responsibility, exploitation, and the systems surrounding him.

💬 “Sometimes, the most dangerous deal is the one that promises you a way out.”

source_details.synopsis: White Boy Rick is a 2018 American crime drama film directed by Yann Demange and written by Andy Weiss, Logan Miller, and Noah Miller. The film stars Matthew McConaughey, Richie Merritt in his film debut, Bel Powley, Jennifer Jason Leigh, Brian Tyree Henry, Rory Cochrane, RJ Cyler, Jonathan Majors, Eddie Marsan, Bruce Dern, and Piper Laurie in her final film role. The film is loosely based on the story of Richard Wershe Jr., who in the 1980s became the youngest FBI informant ever at the age of 14.
